why: Goal requires recoverable code and evidence; tracked documentation should not rely solely on ignored local links. This changes delivery packaging only, never runtime or acceptance gates.
small_evidence: original plans and prospective coverage amendment plus freeze/order/review records
exact commands, clean source/build identities and prior independent proof reuse
all executed terminal decisions and any failures; original decisions unchanged
concise independent resource summary with full raw-audit SHA and limits
explicit conditional-delivery triggered/skipped status with frozen appendix and relevant reviews
raw manifest path/size/SHA/stage/type and origin-to-archive identity mapping
dependencies: immutable raw-resource core exact byte snapshot; bind source SHA and existing core verification evidence
existing tracked runtime/tools and fixture generators identified by commit/file SHA
small necessary boundary fixtures or deterministic generation inputs if generator unavailable
limitations: Git packet is not a backup of all raw evidence; hashes do not replace the originals
Archived controls bind absolute original paths/source/one-shot outputs; do not claim portable direct execution or run them in place
A new experiment requires new paths and new frozen identities; no mutation of original evidence
Document-only/archive commit differs from runtime source commit; prove runtime and actually executed tool bytes unchanged without rebuilding/retesting
final_docs: docs/log/<actual local completion date>.md and index if new
protection: Only explicitly add own isolated-worktree files
Original main seven dirty files and main binary remain untouched
